Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units. Source activities and compound_structures. Join activities to molecule_dictionary on molregno, then to compound_structures on molregno. Filter by assay_id matching CHEMBL1054503, standard_value is not null, and standard_relation equals '='. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
